name: Holy See (Vatican City) — Energy access
blurb: Energy access for Holy See (Vatican City): Electricity, heating, transport fuel — the metabolic substrate of modern life. Driven by 1 of 13 CIA World Factbook indicators.
mechanism:
This model captures the **energy access** dimension of human need for **Holy See (Vatican City)**.

It ingests the relevant slice of the CIA World Factbook (see indicators.json) and produces a composite satisfaction score in [0,1] together with a category-level embedding that feeds the unsupervised macro-space model.

Engine: `closed-form`. The closed-form variant scores indicators on a normalised piecewise-linear ladder per indicator type and aggregates by capability-weighted mean. The Monte-Carlo variant samples from per-indicator uncertainty distributions to produce interval estimates and feed the supervised hold-out predictions.

Frameworks: MaxNeef:subsistence, SDG-7.

components.name: Factbook ingester
components.role: Pulls the relevant factbook fields and normalises units.

components.name: Closed-form scorer
components.role: Maps normalised indicators to a [0,1] satisfaction score.

components.name: Indicator embedder
components.role: Produces a category-level embedding feeding the macro-space model.
